mapper.select: SELECT d.dev_id AS id,coalesce(d.main_job_cd,'') AS job,coalesce(d.grd_cd,'') AS grade,d.emp_se_cd AS employee,d.hire_dt AS hire,d.rsgn_dt AS resign, (SELECT c.indv_lbr_cst_amt FROM cst.mth_cst c WHERE c.dev_id=d.dev_id AND c.cst_ym<=#{month} AND c.emp_se_cd IN ('FT','CT') AND c.duty_se_cd='DIRECT' ORDER BY c.cst_ym DESC LIMIT 1) AS labor FROM mst.dev d WHERE d.use_yn='Y' AND d.duty_se_cd='DIRECT' ORDER BY d.dev_id
SELECT dev_id AS developer,bgn_dt AS start,end_dt AS end FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist WHERE work_stts_cd IN ('VACATION','PARENTAL','UNPAID','LEAVE','RESIGN')

SELECT a.asgn_id AS id,a.prj_id AS project,a.dev_id AS developer,a.job_cd AS job,coalesce(d.grd_cd,'') AS grade, a.bgn_dt AS start,a.end_dt AS end,a.ext_psblty_cd AS extension FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id WHERE a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' ORDER BY a.asgn_id

SELECT m.asgn_id AS assignment,m.work_ym AS month,m.mm_qty AS mm, CASE WHEN a.asgn_se_cd='FREE' THEN 0 ELSE (SELECT u.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist u WHERE u.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND u.aply_bgn_dt<=(to_date(m.work_ym||'-01','YYYY-MM-DD')+interval '1 month - 1 day')::date ORDER BY u.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1) END AS price FROM asgn.asgn_mth m JOIN asgn.asgn a ON a.asgn_id=m.asgn_id WHERE a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED'

SELECT prj_id AS id,cntrct_ty_cd AS type,coalesce(prfm_bgn_dt,cntrct_bgn_dt) AS start, coalesce(cur_end_dt,cntrct_end_dt) AS end,cur_cntrct_amt AS amount FROM prj.prj WHERE use_yn='Y' AND prj_stts_cd IN ('RUN','HOLD')

SELECT s.prj_id AS project,s.plan_ym AS month,s.job_cd AS job,s.grd_cd AS grade,sum(s.need_mm_qty) AS mm FROM prj.psn_plan s JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=s.prj_id WHERE p.use_yn='Y' AND p.prj_stts_cd IN ('RUN','HOLD') GROUP BY s.prj_id,s.plan_ym,s.job_cd,s.grd_cd

SELECT o.oppt_id AS id,o.expc_amt AS amount,o.expc_bgn_ym AS start,o.expc_mnth_qty AS months,o.win_prblt_rt AS probability FROM bsn.oppt o WHERE o.oppt_stts_cd='OPEN' AND o.expc_bgn_ym IS NOT NULL AND o.expc_mnth_qty>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bsn.oppt_need n WHERE n.oppt_id=o.oppt_id AND n.use_yn='Y' AND n.job_cd=#{job}AND n.grd_cd=#{grade}) ORDER BY o.oppt_id

SELECT n.oppt_id AS opportunity,n.job_cd AS job,coalesce(n.grd_cd,'') AS grade,n.bgn_ym AS start,n.mnth_qty AS months,n.psn_cnt AS people,n.mth_mm_qty AS mm,o.win_prblt_rt AS probability FROM bsn.oppt_need n JOIN bsn.oppt o ON o.oppt_id=n.oppt_id WHERE o.oppt_stts_cd='OPEN' AND n.use_yn='Y'

SELECT n.job_cd AS job,coalesce(n.grd_cd,'') AS grade,t.bgn_ym AS start,coalesce(t.end_ym,t.bgn_ym) AS end,t.mm_qty AS mm FROM asgn.tmpr_asgn t JOIN bsn.oppt_need n ON n.need_id=t.need_id JOIN bsn.oppt o ON o.oppt_id=n.oppt_id WHERE t.tmpr_asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND o.oppt_stts_cd='OPEN' AND n.use_yn='Y'
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM cmn.cd_dtl WHERE cd_grp_id=#{job} AND dtl_cd=#{grade} AND use_yn='Y')
